title: WebSockets and bidirectional systems
subtitle: Engineer duplex sessions with identity, flow control, and reconnection.
goal: Design a duplex session rather than an untyped pipe
intro: WebSockets carry messages in both directions; the application must define identity, ordering, flow control, and recovery.
case: A user interrupts live audio while receiving response frames.
Control messages remain responsive even when bulk output is queued.
A connected socket does not prove an action was processed.
